name: yieldshield-monad

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @yieldshield/core && npm run build -w @yieldshield/sdk && npm run build -w @yieldshield/adapter-solana && npm run build -w @yieldshield/adapter-evm

scripts.build:robinhood: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w web -- --mode robinhood-testnet
